interest: Japan's navy restricted foreign ship repairs in 1934; P. and O. was the consul's source.
overview: Grew's January 20, 1934 telegram and paraphrase: Japanese naval authorities told dockyards to refuse foreign repair orders over thirty days ahead.

subfiles.about: Ambassador Grew reports Japanese naval instructions restricting domestic dockyards from booking foreign ship repairs more than 30 days in advance.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports Japanese naval authorities told dockyards not to accept foreign repair orders more than thirty days ahead, keeping docks free for emergencies.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 10 from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew to the Secretary of State regarding Japanese dockyard repair restrictions

subfiles.about: A State Department paraphrase of Ambassador Grew's telegram concerning Japanese naval restrictions on foreign ship repairs in domestic dockyards.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrase of Grew's January 20, 1934 telegram on naval limits on foreign ship repairs, prepared for ONI and MID.
subfiles.title: Paraphrase of Telegram No. 10 from Tokyo on foreign ship repairs in Japanese dockyards
